const cols = header.split(',');
const rows = lines.map(l => Object.fromEntries(l.split(',').map((v, i) => [cols[i], v.trim()])));
return rows.filter(r => !TEST_IDS.length || TEST_IDS.includes(r.account_id)).map(json => ({ json }));

// One account per loop pass. Later nodes read it with $('Current Account').first().
return $input.all();

You are a B2B account researcher. You write short, factual briefs for a sales team.
Use only the data given. Never invent facts, numbers, people or events.
Reply with JSON only. No markdown and no text outside the JSON.

You write the first line of a cold email to a B2B sales leader.
Rules:
- One sentence, 25 words or fewer.
- Tie it to the specific signal and the company by name.
- Plain and specific. No greeting, no flattery, no exclamation marks.
- Never use: "I hope this finds you", "I came across", "quick question", "touch base".
- Use only the facts given. Never invent numbers or events.
Reply with JSON only: {"first_line": "..."}
